events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Launch work and set the success tests
events.decision: Which Quinta Azul data and Spanish buyer contacts will the team get access to?
agenda: Present the phases, gates and what each phase delivers
Discuss access to Quinta Azul data and Spanish buyers
Align on measurable definitions of 'attractive enough' and 'go'

events.label: Workshop: first findings
events.purpose: Review early market and buyer evidence
events.decision: Which buyer listing criteria should the gap assessment of Quinta Azul's assets test?
agenda: Present market, channel and competitor findings
Review buyer interview findings on listing criteria
Decide the criteria for the capability gap assessment

events.label: Findings sign-off
events.purpose: Decide whether Spain justifies entry design
events.decision: Against the agreed tests, is Spain attractive enough to justify designing entry options?
agenda: Present the findings pack for the attractiveness decision
Review buyer and shopper needs and the capability gaps
Decide whether Spain meets the agreed attractiveness tests

events.label: Check-in: business case
events.purpose: Review entry options and business case
events.decision: Which entry option should the entry plan and roadmap detail?
agenda: Present entry options compared on agreed criteria
Review the business case for the go or no-go decision
Decide which option the roadmap details

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Approve the go or no-go and entry plan
events.decision: Approve the Spain go or no-go decision and, if go, the entry plan?
agenda: Present the entry plan and roadmap for Spain
Review the business case against the agreed 'go' test
Decide whether to approve the go or no-go and entry plan
